messages:
ana: spotting a small but reproducible mis-attribution: projectless keys showing up under the wrong org in the console. Repro and short trace below.

ana: minimal repro:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer projless_live_77" -H "X-Request-ID: r-live-77" \
  -H "X-Org: prev-tenant" https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Response includes `X-Org: prev-tenant` but auth DB says owner=current-tenant -> console counts to prev-tenant.

mike: sounds like header-bleed on kept-alive conn + our fast-path skip of enrichment. We introduced that to shave ms at p99.

jon: quick options: (A) always overwrite `X-Org` post-auth (safer, perf hit), (B) auth-service emits internal `X-Auth-Owner` signed header and edge trusts that (lower perf cost), (C) strip client headers and rely only on token claims/lookup. Thoughts?

ana: prefer B if we can mitigate spoofing. Performance matters for high-throughput customers.

mike: agree. Implementation sketch: auth-service resolves owner for projectless keys and adds `X-Internal-Auth-Owner: <org>` and `X-Auth-Signature: hmac256(<org>|<req_id>)`. Edge strips incoming client headers, validates HMAC, writes `X-Telemetry-Owner` when FF enabled. Telemetry prefers `X-Telemetry-Owner`.

jon: security checklist: ensure edge strips any incoming `X-Internal-Auth-Owner` and `X-Telemetry-Owner` from clients. Provide HMAC key rotation support and log verification failures to a metric `auth_sig_verify_failures`.

telemetry-bot: metric proposal: `attribution_conflict_total` (counter), `attribution_conflict_sample` (log N request_ids + both owners to S3), and `attribution_delta_pct_by_org` (gauge). Emit while canary is on.

ana: rollout proposal: FF `prefer_internal_owner` default off. Canary 5% internal for 6h -> evaluate conflict rate, quota deltas, support noise. If OK -> 30% sandbox 24h -> 100% after signoff. Rollback by toggling FF.

mike: QA: add spoofing tests (client sends fake `X-Internal-Auth-Owner` and `X-Auth-Signature`). Edge must reject invalid sigs and fallback to old behavior while incrementing `auth_sig_verify_failures`. Also add latency smoke tests to compare p99 before/after.

jon: console UX: show both values on request detail when they differ e.g. "asserted: current-tenant | observed: prev-tenant" with link to sample logs. That will help support triage.

ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: canary window reserved 2026-05-03 02:00-05:00 UTC. Oncall notified.

mike: I'll take the edge change + FF wiring. Ana will own telemetry/dashboard and console badge. Jon will implement auth header + HMAC and rotation. QA to write tests. I'll open PRs and post links here.

ana: thanks team. I'll draft the rollout doc and include the exact dashboards/alerts to watch. Ping me when PRs are up so I can link them in the doc. :thumbsup:
